name: bff-interpreter
description: High-performance Brainfuck virtual machine for BFF microservices and browsers
author: mat-ocl <mat-ocl@pm.me>

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && esbuild src/browser.ts --bundle --minify=false --format=iife --global-name=BFF --target=es2020 --footer:js="var BrainfuckVM = BFF.BrainfuckVM;" --outfile=bff-interpreter.js
